compare.proofLabel: A real example, not an assertion
compare.proofBody: When we pointed Marketwise at our own homepage, its live research surfaced Mirra — an AI marketing co-founder tool at £49/month that launched after most chatbots' training data froze. Ask a raw ChatGPT prompt about your market and it politely describes last year.
cc.label: The fine print, up front
cc.title: What Marketwise can and cannot know
cc.can1: Read your live site — every page, tag, heading and price it renders today
cc.can2: Search the web now and cite every source it used
cc.can3: Verify competitors exist, live, before writing a word about them
cc.cannot1: See your analytics, ad accounts or sales data — it never asks for them
cc.cannot2: Know your internal roadmap, team constraints or budget
cc.cannot3: Guarantee outcomes — it ranks what to fix by expected impact; you decide what ships
pc.pro.support: Priority support — your questions jump the queue
pc.pro.tracking: Room to re-audit monthly and prove what moved
pc.onetime.label: Not ready to subscribe?
pc.onetime.title: One report, one payment
pc.onetime.body: The full analysis — live market and competitor research, the five-part site audit, a scored report and a 7/30/60/90-day roadmap. One website, no subscription.
